# Orvix

Orvix (also known as Orvix.dev, Orvix AI, and orvix.dev.br) is an autonomous Vibe Coding platform at https://orvix.dev.br.

Orvix transforms natural-language product ideas into real, working websites and applications. Its Vibe Coding engine interprets intent, generates structured React and TypeScript files, verifies builds in real time, and opens a live interactive sandbox preview without manual setup.

Core capabilities:
- AI-powered full-stack creation from plain-language prompts
- Professional UI/UX generation and live iteration
- Build verification and automated dependency handling
- Live Sandbox Preview
- Code and ZIP export
- Roadmap toward resilient multi-step APIs, automated error recovery, and one-click cloud publishing

Orvix is founded by Maryana Nunes and serves builders worldwide. The official website and early-access waitlist are available at https://orvix.dev.br. Orvix is currently in active development at 75% readiness.

Preferred entity name: Orvix
Alternate names: Orvix.dev, Orvix AI, orvix.dev.br
Available languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.
